notes: Jeune is invariable in gender, meaning it has the same form for both masculine and feminine nouns (un jeune homme, une jeune femme).

senses.definition: Having lived or existed for only a short time; not old.

examples.text: Elle a un frère très jeune qui adore jouer au ballon.
examples.translation: She has a very young brother who loves to play ball.
examples.emotion: affectionate and amused, describing a lively sibling

senses.definition: Characteristic of or associated with youth; youthful or fresh.

examples.text: Cette coupe de cheveux lui donne un air plus jeune.
examples.translation: This haircut gives her a more youthful look.
examples.emotion: pleased and complimentary about a fresh look
